claim.quote: This is the first observation of $C\!P$ violation in the decay of charm hadrons.

date.quote: This is the first observation of CP violation in the decay of charm hadrons.

key_value_text.quote: Combining these with previous LHCb results leads to ΔA_CP = (-15.4 ± 2.9) x 10^-4, where the uncertainty includes both statistical and systematic contributions.

name: Observation of CP violation in charm decays

significance.quote: The measured value differs from zero by more than five standard deviations.

summary.plain: For the first time, LHCb caught charm quarks behaving slightly differently from their antimatter counterparts, completing a set of matter-antimatter asymmetry observations across all quark families that carry this kind of charge.
summary.technical: Measurement of the CP-asymmetry difference ΔA_CP between D0->K-K+ and D0->pi-pi+ decays using 6 fb-1 of 13 TeV pp data; combined with previous LHCb results, ΔA_CP = (-15.4±2.9)x10^-4, differing from zero by more than five standard deviations - the first observation of CP violation in the charm sector.

title: Observation of CP Violation in Charm Decays
why_it_matters: CP violation had previously been observed in kaon and B-meson decays but never in the charm sector; observing it in charm decays, at a rate broadly consistent with (if on the larger side of) Standard Model expectations, tests the last unconfirmed corner of quark-sector CP violation and constrains new-physics contributions.
